messages:
Elaine: Heads-up — Acme Sec returned our SIG subset with heavy focus on encryption/KMS. They need HSM-backed BYOK, proof keys never leave HSM, rotation policy, and 2yr audit retention. POC scheduled Tue; can we confirm feasible flows? @Sam @Marta

Sam: TL;DR options we should present:
- Hosted (default): envelope encryption; customers can manage keys via cloud KMS—no raw-key BYOK in host mode.
- Dedicated: connect to customer HSM via KMIP or use cloud HSM and expose usage without exporting key material.
- Private: full on-prem BYOK (PKCS#11/KMIP) — keys stay in customer's HSM and Redwood only stores references.

Marta: couple questions to lock down before POC:
- Is generation-in-HSM mandatory, or is wrapped-import acceptable?
- FIPS level required?
- Audit log retention window and required events?

acme-sec: generation must happen inside *our* HSM and never leave. Wrapped-import only OK if wrapping key is inside our HSM. FIPS 140-2 L3 required. Audit logs retained for 2 years. POC must demonstrate no plaintext ever in Redwood control plane.

Sam: Understood. That maps to two concrete patterns:
1) Customer on-prem HSM + KMIP bridge -> Redwood Private (we never hold key material; we make KMIP calls)
2) CloudHSM BYOK -> keys generated in CloudHSM, Redwood granted usage via EKM/connector; HSM signs/encrypts but key material never exported

Deepak: For the POC, I can provision a Private instance in their VPC and run a KMIP connector. Need either a test Thales or SoftHSM endpoint from Acme and client certs.

Elaine: Legal asked whether we need an addendum for BYOK/HSM. @Ryan do we have a standard BYOK clause?

Ryan: Yes — we have a BYOK addendum template. Key clauses: customer retains custody of key material; Redwood will not extract plaintext; responsibilities for HSM backup/availability; indemnities around key compromise. Also note Dedicated/Private pricing impact. I'll draft and share.

Sam: Tech deliverables for POC:
- Simple architecture diagram
- Minimal test plan (generate key, encrypt/decrypt flow, rotation test, revoke)
- Sample API/curl showing key reference usage (pseudo):

```
# sample: request to encrypt using key alias "acme/prod/k1"
POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/encrypt
Authorization: Bearer <token>
{
  "key_alias": "acme/prod/k1",
  "plaintext": "..."
}
# Redwood forwards to KMIP connector which issues encrypt operation to HSM
```

Marta: For SIG answers (encryption section) we'll include:
- Key lifecycle: generation location, allowed import modes
- Usage model: envelope encryption with per-object DEK
- Rotation semantics: re-wrap DEKs, maintain N previous key versions
- Audit/observability: how we map HSM logs + Redwood logs
- Attestation: HSM certs/serials & FIPS reports

acme-sec: Rotation requirement: every 90 days; must support immediate revoke and documented emergency key eviction playbook.

Sam: Proposed rotation mechanism:
- Active key version + previous K versions retained to allow decryption
- Re-wrap DEKs asynchronously; if immediate revoke, deny at HSM/KMIP layer so new ops fail
- We'll run rotation during POC and demonstrate revoke

Deepak: Pre-POC checklist for Acme:
- KMIP endpoint and client certs
- IP allowlist / VPN creds
- Test HSM account or SoftHSM details
- Which SIG/CAIQ sections to prioritize

Elaine: Pricing note: Private/Dedicated POC has infra/day charge + eng time. I'm lining up numbers — expect a short procurement + MSA + BYOK addendum.

Ryan: I'll prepare the addendum draft and a short sales blurb about BYOK risks/mitigations.

Sam: I'll produce the arch diagram and test plan. Marta owns the SIG encryption answers. Deepak will build KMIP connector. Elaine owns scheduling and pricing. acme-sec, can you send KMIP creds and attestation certs by EOD Friday?

acme-sec: Will send by Fri 17:00 PT. Thanks.

Elaine: Thanks all. Action items recap:
- Sam: arch diagram + POC test plan (due Mon)
- Marta: SIG answers + evidence checklist (due Mon)
- Deepak: KMIP connector + SoftHSM guide (due Mon)
- Ryan: BYOK addendum + sales blurb (due Mon)
- acme-sec: KMIP creds/IP/VPN + certs (due Fri 17:00 PT)

Elaine: Adding follow-up to calendar. :thumbsup:
